guide.guideline_no_raw_values_desc: Do not use raw values like `z-index: 100` on a component's root element. Always refer to the tokens above.
guide.guideline_stacking_context_desc: For overlaps within a component (e.g., slider track and thumb), create an independent stacking context within the component and use relative values.
guide.guideline_portals_desc: Many overlay components use `Portal` to render directly under `body`, minimizing interference from parent `z-index` or `overflow: hidden`.
